*   **$\mathcal{I}_{tre}$**: The set of integers $k$ such that there exists a tree $T$ with exactly $k$ independent sets. That is, $k = i(T)$, where $i(T)$ is the number of independent sets of $T$.
*   **$\dim(\mathcal{I}_{tre})$**: This is defined as the lower growth exponent (or lower Minkowski dimension) of the subset of natural numbers $\mathcal{I}_{tre}$.
    \[
    \dim(\mathcal{I}_{tre}) = \liminf_{N\to\infty} \frac{\log |\mathcal{I}_{tre} \cap \{1, \dots, N\}|}{\log N}.
